## Problem

What annoys you today? One or two sentences.

## Proposal

What should change?

## Privacy impact (required)

SkinShift's promise: zero network requests, no conversation access, fail
quietly. Does your proposal touch any of these? If yes, how is the promise
kept? Proposals that weaken the promise need a strong reason.

## Alternatives considered

What else did you think of, and why is this better?

## Willing to contribute?

- [ ] I can open a PR for this (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)).
